name: CBA Night at the Museum SCZ 2026
information:
This competition will be held as part of 'The Long Night of Museums' at the Centro Boliviano Americano (CBA). It will be an unforgettable evening celebrating our culture and showcasing the extraordinary talent of our speedcubers to the entire city. This competition is open to all public.
To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CBANightattheMuseumSCZ2026#74580-informacion-de-pago)

**More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CBANightattheMuseumSCZ2026#74578-faq-pmf)**

Esta competencia se celebrará en el marco de 'La Larga Noche de Museos' en el Centro Boliviano Americano (CBA). Será una velada inolvidable para celebrar nuestra cultura y mostrar el extraordinario talento de nuestros speedcubers a toda la ciudad. Esta competencia esta abierta a todo publico.
Para ver la informacion acerca del pago de inscripcion entra al siguiente [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CBANightattheMuseumSCZ2026#74580-informacion-de-pago)

**Mas informacion acerca de las competencias ingresar a: [Preguntas frecuentes / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CBANightattheMuseumSCZ2026#74578-faq-pmf)**
